script: Decision: covered. The claimant reports floodwater reaching the floorboards and the vehicle subsequently failing to start; water and flood are covered other-than-collision causes under the supplied clauses. Coverage prerequisites are established by DEMO-DECL, with payment subject to the applicable limit and declarations deductible, whose amounts are not supplied. Next action: Approve coverage and calculate payment using the repair estimate, applicable limit, and declarations deductible.
